=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4326-4328 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Merge commit 474b608 took #10205's `timeout-minutes: 81` budget for orchestrate-decompose-test (3000s watch + 1500s dispatch rate-limit cap + 360s = 4860s). That dropped this PR's +20 minute raise, so the budget does not cover the up-to-1200s worst-case wait of each gh_api_retry read (GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3, GH_RETRY_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS=600) in the dispatch step (TRACKING_NUMBER, CAP_JOB_IDS, JOB_LOG, CAP_TRACKERS, CHILDREN_JSON) and the cleanup step (STRAGGLERS, PROJECT_PRS_PAGE).
  WHY: If the PAT is rate-limited, the job runs past 4860s and GitHub cancels it before the always() cleanup finishes, which breaks the acceptance rule "No step's worst-case wait plus its work exceeds its timeout-minutes". test_pat_jobs_bound_helper_waits only asserts 1200 < 81*60, so it misses this. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high). Supporting refs: line 4409, line 4412, env lines 4334-4335, cleanup reads lines 4717-4745. Suggested fix: timeout-minutes 101.
- changelog.d/10225-gate-rate-limit-helpers.md and agents.d/10225-gate-rate-limit-helpers.md:n/a | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Both fragments describe a 20-minute timeout raise for orchestrate-decompose-test (changelog row "`orchestrate-decompose-test` 60 to 80"), but that raise is not in the workflow after the merge, which still has 81 at line 4328.
  WHY: When the fragments are folded into CHANGELOG and agents.md, operators and later agents will believe the job budget covers the gh_api_retry worst case when it does not. Rated NIT (mapped to low).
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:145-181 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fail-closed guard at line 181 (`[ "$TOTAL_JOBS" -eq 0 ] && [ "${dv_last_rc}" -ne 0 ]`) checks only the rc of the last read. A confirmed spurious re-trigger has an rc 0 read with `{"jobs":[]}`; if a later indexing-delay recheck returns rc 75 or rc 2, line 156 overwrites dv_last_rc, the loop breaks, and the run gets DEEP_PASS=false with "Jobs listing unavailable".
  WHY: A rate limit during the recheck fails the deep-verify gate near the end of a 3+ hour e2e-smoke-test. That is the outcome #10225 is meant to remove. tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_deep_verify_fail_closed.py only stubs a uniform rc, so this mixed sequence is untested. Severity was NIT from sonnet, minimax and glm (mapped to low); gemini stated none. Confidence ranged from 2 to 4. Suggested fix: a dv_seen_ok flag.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  EVIDENCE: The timeout is still #10205's 81 minutes (3000 + 1500 + 360 s = 4860 s), which leaves no room for the 1200s worst-case gh_api_retry wait added to the dispatch and cleanup reads (TRACKING_NUMBER line 4524, CAP_JOB_IDS 4543, JOB_LOG 4546, CAP_TRACKERS 4568, CHILDREN_JSON 4609, STRAGGLERS 4717, PROJECT_PRS_PAGE 4733/4736/4740; env lines 4331-4335). === FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:lines 4326-4328, 4409, 4412 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Merge 474b608 took #10205's 81-minute budget (4860s, 360s slack) and dropped the PR's +20 min raise. Each gh_api_retry read in dispatch (TRACKING_NUMBER, CAP_JOB_IDS, JOB_LOG, CAP_TRACKERS, CHILDREN_JSON) and cleanup (STRAGGLERS, PROJECT_PRS_PAGE) can wait up to 1200s, and that wait is not budgeted. tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py::test_pat_jobs_bound_helper_waits only checks 1200 < 81*60.
  WHY: A rate-limited PAT pushes the job past 4860s, GitHub cancels it, the always() cleanup does not finish, and the gate fails. That breaks the acceptance rule. Fix: timeout-minutes 101, update comments at 4326-4327 and 4409, assert the sum in the test.
- changelog.d/10225-gate-rate-limit-helpers.md and agents.d/10225-gate-rate-limit-helpers.md:changelog row "Raised job limits | `orchestrate-decompose-test` 60 to 80, ..."; agents.d "got 20 more minutes of `timeout-minutes`" | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fragments describe a timeout change that is not in the file after the merge (still 81 at line 4328).
  WHY: Once folded into CHANGELOG and agents.md, they will mislead operators and agents about the job budget. Fix the timeout or correct both fragments.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:check_all_steps, line 156, lines 163-170, line 181 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The fail-closed verdict uses only the last read's rc. An rc 0 empty listing followed by an rc 75/2 recheck gets DEEP_PASS=false with "Jobs listing unavailable". The test only covers a uniform rc.
  WHY: A rate limit during the recheck of a spurious re-trigger fails deep verify near the end of a 3+ hour e2e-smoke-test. Fix: `local dv_seen_ok=0`, set on rc 0, and add `&& [ "${dv_seen_ok}" -eq 0 ]` to line 181 (~4 lines).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Bound each wait by the step's remaining budget ... raise the step limit rather than shorten the wait (this is the same decision issue #10205 asks for; do not make the two contradict each other)." Acceptance: "No step's worst-case wait plus its work exceeds its timeout-minutes"
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, orchestrate-decompose-test timeout-minutes (line 4328) and its budget comments (lines 4326-4327 and 4406-4409).
  Evidence of absence: The timeout is still 81 (3000 + 1500 + 360 s). Several reads with a 1200s worst case were routed through gh_api_retry, but no hunk raises the timeout. clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test (30 to 50) and e2e-alt-model-test (90 to 110) were raised; this job was not. The changelog row "60 to 80" is stale.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py, test_pat_jobs_bound_helper_waits. It only checks `worst < timeout-minutes * 60` and ignores DISPATCH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS and the watch budget. Fix: assert dispatch cap + worst < timeout*60 - watch budget, or pin timeout-minutes >= 101 (4-6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
